text: [256] 52 khemaṃ khemanti āvuso vuccati kittāvatā nu kho āvuso khemaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti . idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi .pe. paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati ettāvatāpi kho āvuso khemaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā pariyāyena .pe. puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti ettāvatāpi kho āvuso khemaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti .
